# Escape hatch for scripts/check_added_chinese.py (card LANG1, docs/sessions.md §6).
#
# Paths here may gain Chinese lines without failing CI. Use it only for a case
# the exceptions in docs/sessions.md §6 do not name; for one line, prefer the
# marker `lang-check: allow` on that line. Every entry is
#
#     <path glob>  # <reason>
#
# `*` stays inside one directory, `**` crosses directories. An entry without a
# reason fails the check, and so does one that would cover most of the
# repository: an entry names one file, or has two directory levels before its
# first wildcard (docs/archive/** is fine; **, **/*.md and docs/** are not).
#
# CI checks a change against the BASE commit's copy of this file, so an entry
# lands in its own PR before the Chinese it allows. Adding a path here is a
# review item: say why in the PR.
